title: Hadith on Sacrificing Afterlife for Worldly Gain
summary: The worst person is one who sacrifices the afterlife for worldly benefits.
translation: Narrated by Hazrat Abu Umamah Bahili (may Allah be pleased with him): In a hadith recorded in Ibn Majah, the Noble Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said that on the Day of Judgment, the worst person in status will be the one who sacrifices the afterlife for worldly means. The meaning is that preferring worldly benefits over the benefits of the afterlife for one's personal gain is a severe wrongdoing and a major sin. However, this wrongdoing becomes much more severe when one seeks worldly gain for someone else, thereby oppressing others and ruining their own afterlife. This is akin to those who, lacking foresight and driven by self-interest, assist wrongdoers and oppressors, thus incurring loss for themselves.
